title: Subject-Wise Peer Study-Buddy Matcher
problem: Students struggling in maths feel shy to ask teachers for help, and don't know which friends in their rooms are strong in maths problem-solving.
idea: A study-buddy matcher. Each student writes their strong and weak subjects, Gemini makes pairs, and we put a colourful buddy chart on the dorm wall. Try finding your buddy type.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Which subject do you need help with?
widgets.intro: Tap your weak subject to see the kind of buddy you will get.
widgets.question: I need help with:

options.label: Maths
options.result: Your buddy: a friend strong in Maths. Meet 20 minutes after dinner to solve 5 sums together.
options.te: మీ బడ్డీ: లెక్కల్లో బాగా చేసే స్నేహితుడు. భోజనం తర్వాత 20 నిమిషాలు 5 లెక్కలు చేయండి.

options.label: Science
options.result: Your buddy: a friend strong in Science. Draw and explain one diagram each day.
options.te: మీ బడ్డీ: సైన్స్‌లో బాగా చేసే స్నేహితుడు. రోజూ ఒక బొమ్మ గీసి వివరించుకోండి.

options.label: English
options.result: Your buddy: a friend strong in English. Read one page aloud to each other every day.
options.te: మీ బడ్డీ: ఇంగ్లీష్‌లో బాగా చేసే స్నేహితుడు. రోజూ ఒక పేజీ బిగ్గరగా చదవండి.

options.label: I am strong in all
options.result: Great! Become a buddy-teacher and help a junior friend.
options.te: చాలా బాగుంది! ఒక జూనియర్‌కి బడ్డీ టీచర్‌గా సహాయం చేయండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Am I a good study buddy?

items.text: I explain slowly and don't laugh at mistakes.
I let my buddy try first before showing the answer.
We meet at the same time every day.
I ask a teacher when we both are stuck.
I say thank you to my buddy.

bands.text: Good buddy. Add a few more habits.
Start with being kind and patient.

how: Give each student a small slip: name, room, strong subject, weak subject (with the warden's permission).
Type the list (first names only) into Gemini and ask it to make pairs: strong in one subject + weak in the same subject.
Check the pairs with the class teacher and change any that won't work.
Open Canva, search 'chart' and make a colourful buddy chart with one colour per subject.
Print it and stick it on the dorm notice board.
After 2 weeks, ask everyone if their buddy is helping, and make new pairs if needed.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Here is a list of my classmates with their strong and weak subjects: [paste list]. Make study-buddy pairs so each weak student gets a friend who is strong in that subject. Show the result as a simple table.
